description: This Java class 'JWTValidator' provides functionality to validate JWT tokens using Nimbus JOSE+JWT library, including setting expected audience, matching claims, required claims, and processing JWTs with specified algorithms.

classes.name: JWTValidator
classes.description: A class for validating JWT tokens with configurable audience, claims, and algorithms, using Nimbus JOSE+JWT library.

methods.name: JWTValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing JWTProcessor with a JWK source and setting a JOSE object type verifier.

methods.name: withExpectedAudience
methods.description: Sets the expected audience for JWT validation if the input is not blank.

methods.name: withMatchingClaims
methods.description: Sets matching claims for validation if the input map is not empty.

methods.name: withRequiredClaims
methods.description: Sets required claims for validation if the input set is not empty.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a JWT string, verifying signature, audience, and claims, returning JWTClaimsSet or throwing AuthenticationException.
